blocks.text: Condo buildings in Ladner Elementary
Fentons Court — 4988 47A Avenue

A boutique low-rise beside the village core: a building profile records 3 floors and an estimated completion of 1990, with underground parking and storage, and 1- to 3-bedroom homes. The same profile states both "20 homes" in its text and "36" units in its details table.
Park Regent Estates — 4989 47 Avenue

Building-directory data (BC Condos and Homes, secondary source) records it as built in 1988, with pets allowed with restrictions and rentals allowed with restrictions, and amenities of elevator, in-suite laundry and storage. A unit listing describes it as a self-managed, pet-friendly and rental-friendly building directly across from a park, and records a 1987 build year.
Seafarer Marina Estates — 4803 48 Avenue

Waterfront condos by the marina: listings classify homes here as Apartment/Condo, built 1985, with a 30-foot boat slip attached to at least one unit, elevator access, and a newer windows and roof noted in listing copy.
Delta Green — 4686 51 Street

The sub-area's known 55+ building: listings describe "premier 55+ living in the heart of Ladner Village directly across from Memorial Park & the library", Apartment/Condo form, built 2021, wood-frame construction, freehold strata, with a rooftop deck, fitness gym and secure bike room. The 55+ restriction is listing-stated — confirm the registered age bylaw, because only a 55+ bylaw is lawful.
Bridge & Elliott — 4905 Elliott Street (site also described as 4989 Bridge Street), Ladner Village
Wood-frame construction is the developer's stated building model, per trade coverage of Headwater.
Village Gardens, 4949 47A Avenue; Parkside Place, 5053 47 Avenue; Mountainview Terrace, 4925 Elliott Street; Apex Homes, 4829 48 Avenue
Do not publish details for them without strata documents.
Manor House — 4569 Arthur Drive
A boutique townhouse-style strata development, recorded in listings as built in 2025, 3 storeys, inspired by late Victorian architecture — ground-oriented homes, not an apartment building.
Faireharbour — 4904 47A Avenue
A townhouse complex recorded in listings as built in 1976 — townhouses, not apartment condos.
Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: The working area is central Ladner around Ladner Elementary School at 5016 44 Avenue, Memorial Park at 5010 47 Ave, and Arthur Drive, based on the school and park addresses on SD37 and City of Delta pages. No official boundary for the sub-area is published by the City.
The village core sits west of Chilukthan Slough; the OCP's Ladner Village Core material addresses the Village's historic buildings, which shapes renovation and redevelopment in the core.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates: two pockets. First, the 47 Avenue / 47A Avenue blocks east of Memorial Park — Fentons Court, Park Regent Estates and their neighbours. Second, the village core itself — Delta Green on 51 Street, the Seafarer Marina buildings on 48 Avenue by the river, and the Bridge & Elliott presale at Bridge and Elliott Streets.

Transit: route 609 runs between South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange via Arthur Drive and Ladner Trunk Road, serving the Ladner Elementary and Delta Secondary area; route 601 runs from South Delta to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) via Ladner Exchange.

Schools physically in Ladner include Ladner Elementary, 5016 44 Ave; Delta Secondary, 4615 51 St; Hawthorne Elementary, 5160 Central Ave; Holly Elementary, 4625 62 St; Neilson Grove Elementary, 5500 Admiral Blvd; and Port Guichon Elementary, 4381 46A St.

Cromie Park is at 4907 42b Ave, Ladner Leisure Centre at 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent, Ladner Pioneer Library at 4683 51st Street, and Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, has the Ladner Exchange bus loop next door.

Age bylaws: only 55+ survives — directly relevant to Delta Green: Under Strata Property Act ss. 123.1 and 123.2, a strata may restrict residents to 55 or older; any age bylaw below 55 has been invalid since Nov 24, 2022. The bylaw restricts who may live in the unit, not who may own it, and exemptions cover legacy residents, live-in caregivers, and — since May 1, 2023 — a younger spouse or partner and defined children of a qualifying resident (Strata Property Regulation 7.01).

Presale rules (REDMA) — directly relevant to Bridge & Elliott: A presale buyer must receive a disclosure statement, and under s. 21 of the Real Estate Development Marketing Act the buyer has seven days to rescind, starting on the later of signing the purchase agreement or signing the written acknowledgement of the disclosure statement; deposits are generally held in trust.

Delta zoning: Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, and the village development permit areas: Zoning is parcel-by-parcel under Bylaw No. 7600, and the OCP adds the Ladner Village (LV1) and Ladner Village Core (LVC) development permit areas — the LVC guidelines address the Village's historic buildings and shape exterior work in the core, which matters for Delta Green, Seafarer and any village-core strata renovation.

OCP: Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), "Housing Our Future": A single consolidated plan with no separate Ladner area plan; farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)". The village's six-storey permission that Bridge & Elliott used came through the December 2021 Ladner Village OCP amendment.

Bridge & Elliott is the village's density turning point. Trade coverage notes multifamily housing has rarely been available in Ladner Village, that Delta council approved the OCP amendment for Ladner Village in December 2021 allowing buildings up to six storeys on the Headwater site, and that the project is now in presale/under construction — the first six-storey condo building in the village core.

The newest resale stock is very new, and very small-scale. Manor House on Arthur Drive completed in 2025 as a boutique townhouse-style strata, and Delta Green added a 55+ apartment building in 2021 — central Ladner's condo supply is growing a few units at a time, not in towers.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Ladner Elementary
Manor House — 4569 Arthur Drive

A boutique townhouse-style strata development: listing data classifies homes here as Townhouse, 3 storeys, built 2025, with one listing's sub-type recorded as Strata and the development described as inspired by late Victorian architecture and built by the Sonnenbergs.
Faireharbour — 4904 47A Avenue

A townhouse complex: listing data classifies homes here as Townhouse, 3 storeys, built 1976, and records a strata fee for current listings (a dated listing figure — confirm the current fee on the Form B), which is the strata evidence.
Apex Homes — 4829 48 Avenue
Townhomes by the marina: listing data classifies homes here as Townhouse form with sub-type Strata, built 2025, and the listing text references units 1, 2 and 6.
48 Landing — 4778 / 4788 48B Street

Row houses by Asanti Homes: listing data classifies the homes as Row House (Non-Strata), 3 storeys, built 2026, on their own small lots, and the listing text calls the offering "a freehold row house in vibrant downtown Ladner." Tenure is FEE-SIMPLE, non-strata — plainly: no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees; the buyer's checks are title, covenants and municipal rules. Because the homes are new construction, GST applies.
Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: Where the townhouse stock actually concentrates: the village-core blocks themselves. Faireharbour and the older strata stock sit on 47A Avenue east of Memorial Park; Manor House stands on Arthur Drive; Apex Homes and the fee-simple 48 Landing row houses stand on 48 Avenue / 48B Street by the river side of the core. The apartment condos concentrate in the same blocks — the two forms interleave here more than anywhere else in Ladner.

Form B first (strata complexes only): Under s. 59 of the Strata Property Act, the Form B Information Certificate discloses the unit's monthly strata fees, amounts the owner owes, approved-but-unpaid special levies, the contingency reserve fund (CRF) balance, parking and storage allocations, and a summary of the strata's insurance; the strata must provide it within 7 days of a request, and the rules, current budget and most recent depreciation report must be attached. Manor House, Faireharbour and Apex Homes purchases run on this document; a 48 Landing purchase has no Form B at all.

Fee-simple, plainly: A 48 Landing row house has no strata corporation, no Form B and no strata fees — the buyer deals with municipal rules (zoning, the village development permit areas below) and any covenants or easements on title only. Insurance, exterior maintenance and drainage are entirely the owner's.

Depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle (strata): Since July 1, 2024, strata corporations with five or more strata lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years and can no longer defer it by a vote; reports carry a 30-year projection and three CRF cash-flow models. For 1976-built Faireharbour, that report is the central diligence document.

Delta zoning — number contested, flagged not settled, plus the village permit areas: City zone sheets cite the zoning bylaw as No. 7600, 2017, parcel by parcel; an internal consolidated title reading "8400, 2025" also circulates — neither number is asserted as settled here. On top of zoning, the OCP's Ladner Village (LV1) and Ladner Village Core (LVC) development permit areas apply in the core — the LVC guidelines address the Village's historic buildings and shape exterior work, which matters for strata exterior renovations and for a fee-simple row house alike.

GST on new construction: 48 Landing homes and any developer-sold new townhouse carry GST; resale townhomes do not. The first-time home buyers' GST/HST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026, per CRA News No. 122) rebates 100% of the GST up to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out to $1.5 million, for agreements in the March 20, 2025–2031 window; the older GST New Housing Rebate is 36% of the GST, maximum $6,300, phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000.

The newest townhouse supply arrived in two tenures at once. Manor House (strata, 2025) on Arthur Drive, Apex Homes (strata, 2025) on 48 Avenue and 48 Landing (fee-simple, 2026) on 48B Street all landed within about a year — central Ladner's townhouse choice went from one 1976 complex (Faireharbour) to four complexes, and the tenure split is the first thing to check on any new listing.

Bridge & Elliott is the village's density turning point — but it is apartments, not townhomes. Trade coverage notes Delta council approved the OCP amendment for Ladner Village in December 2021 allowing buildings up to six storeys on the Headwater site, and the project (131 homes per the developer) is now in presale/under construction — the first six-storey condo building in the village core.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Ladner Elementary
Fee-simple lots

items.t: The default tenure in this sub-area is fee-simple: single detached dwellings on fee-simple lots under the single detached residential zones, with secondary suites as an accessory use in RS1 and SSMUH options under the City's amendments. Fee-simple plainly: no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees.
48 Landing — 4778 / 4788 48B Street.: New construction — GST applies to the home purchase.

Lot character: the urban Ladner ladder runs RS7 335 m² and RS6 390 m² up to RD1 duplex 836 m², with RS1–RS3 and RD2–RD3 at 4,000 m² in lower-density areas; the zone on any parcel is read off the City zoning maps.

blocks.text: Bare-land strata

items.t: A bare-land strata lot is strata tenure: the buyer owns the strata lot (essentially the building lot itself) and the house on it; Form B, strata fees for common property and registered bylaws apply to the lot. It is not fee-simple.

items.t: Bridge & Elliott: 4989 Bridge Street and 4905, 4909 and 4915 Elliott Street, Ladner Village. A development site and presale: a six-storey mixed-use presale by Headwater Projects with 131 homes from studios to three bedrooms, under construction as of the latest developer information.

blocks.text: Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: No official boundary for the sub-area is published by the City; the working area is central Ladner around the school, Memorial Park (5010 47 Ave) and Arthur Drive. Nearby sub-areas: Delta Manor, Hawthorne, Holly, Neilsen Grove (AREA spelling; the SCHOOL is Neilson Grove Elementary), Port Guichon, and Ladner Rural around the village, with Tsawwassen to the south.

Municipality and plan: City of Delta, under the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, "Housing Our Future", Bylaw No. 8400, adopted July 8, 2024 — a single consolidated plan; its Development Permit Areas, including the Ladner Village (LV1) and Ladner Village Core (LVC) areas, live in Appendix B.

Amenities on City/district pages: Cromie Park, 4907 42b Ave; Ladner Leisure Centre, 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent; Ladner Pioneer Library, 4683 51st Street; Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, with the Ladner Exchange bus loop next door.

Bare-land strata block (the form, for any strata lot a buyer meets in Ladner): Form B (SPA s. 59) — fees, amounts owed, approved levies, CRF balance, insurance summary, with rules, budget and most recent depreciation report attached; within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page. Depreciation reports every 5 years for 5+ lots since July 1, 2024. CRF minimum 10% since November 1, 2023. Rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022 (long-term; short-term may still be restricted). Only 55+ age bylaws valid (Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2 and Regulation 7.01, incl. May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is not a valid BC age bylaw. Fee-simple contrast — 48 Landing and the grid's lots carry none of this.
Presales (REDMA) — Bridge & Elliott: disclosure statement required (s. 18, deposits in trust); 7-day rescission from the later of signing or acknowledging it (s. 21).

The sub-area is named for a school, and the spelling rule cuts the other way nearby. The AREA next door is "Neilsen Grove" while its SCHOOL is "Neilson Grove Elementary" (5500 Admiral Blvd) — the two spellings are both correct, for different things, and a search built on the wrong one misses stock.

A fee-simple row house is the exception that proves the fabric. Most new attached product in Ladner is strata; 48 Landing's non-strata form means its owners hold plain fee-simple lots in the downtown grid — no depreciation report, no CRF, no Form B on resale.

The village core's heritage layer predates any lot split. The LVC permit area's historic-building guidelines sit on village-core parcels before zoning math does — a "subdividable" village lot can still be design-constrained.

blocks.text: Duplexes and half duplexes in Ladner Elementary
Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: Flood and streamside (Delta): Delta's flood protection includes dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection managed by the City, with over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure maintained by the City. All properties in Delta within 30 m of a stream — including Chilukthan Slough and other sloughs and ditches — fall within the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area; check the 30 m rule before pricing in an addition or rebuild on a duplex lot. In the village core, check the Ladner Village Core development permit area guidelines as well — they address the Village's historic buildings and can shape exterior renovations.

faq.a: Delta Green is marketed as 55+ living. Provincial rules require an exemption for a younger spouse or partner of a resident who meets the age requirement (or holds a legacy exemption); children can also be exempt in defined cases, and a live-in caregiver is exempt. Confirm the building's registered bylaw itself before relying on the marketing.
faq.q: My spouse is under 55 — can we live at Delta Green?

faq.a: Ownership is not age-restricted — the bylaw governs who may reside — and long-term rental-restriction bylaws are void province-wide. But a tenant must still satisfy the 55+ bylaw or an exemption, which narrows the rental pool by design.
faq.q: Can I buy at Delta Green as an investment and rent it out?

faq.a: Seven days under REDMA s. 21, from the later of signing the purchase agreement or acknowledging the disclosure statement, by written notice to the developer. After that, the contract binds — including its assignment terms.
faq.q: I signed at Bridge & Elliott — how long do I have to change my mind?

faq.a: Yes. A new home carries 5% GST (partly recoverable — up to 100% for eligible first-time buyers to $1 million under Bill C-4), and PTT is charged on the total paid; the newly built home PTT exemption is full to $1,100,000. A resale condo has no GST.
faq.q: Does a presale here get taxed differently from a resale?

faq.a: A current listing describes a unit with its own 30-foot boat slip and river views from a large deck. Whether a slip is assigned, leased or part of the strata lot is a title and Form B question for the specific unit — do not assume the slip transfers on marketing copy alone.
faq.q: What comes with a Seafarer Marina unit — is the boat slip real?

faq.a: Four complexes in two tenures: strata townhouses at Manor House (2025), Faireharbour (1976) and Apex Homes (2025), and fee-simple non-strata row houses at 48 Landing (2026).
faq.q: What is the actual townhouse choice in the village core?

faq.a: Tenure. Manor House is strata: monthly fees, bylaws, a Form B, a CRF and a depreciation report. 48 Landing is fee-simple: no fees and no bylaws, but also no strata carrying the roof, exterior or shared systems — and as new construction it carries GST, partly recoverable for eligible first-time buyers under Bill C-4.
faq.q: What is the practical difference between 48 Landing and Manor House?

faq.a: The depreciation report and the minutes. A strata of five or more lots must refresh its depreciation report every five years since July 1, 2024; its envelope, roof and drainage items, plus the CRF balance and any approved-but-unpaid levy on the Form B, are the purchase.
faq.q: Faireharbour was built in 1976 — what should I check first?

faq.a: A duplex purchase here is an individual building on a single lot under the RD zones, verified on its title.
faq.q: Is there a duplex development in the Ladner Elementary area I can buy into?

faq.a: No. 48 Landing is fee-simple non-strata ROW houses — each is a complete dwelling on its own lot, not one half of a two-unit building. It carries no strata, no Form B and no strata fees; municipal rules and any covenants or easements on title govern.
faq.q: Is a 48 Landing row house a half duplex?

faq.a: Not automatically — the sub-area name is a school name, not a guarantee.
faq.q: If I buy in this sub-area, will my kids automatically attend Ladner Elementary?

faq.a: Yes, where the zone allows — the RS1 zone lists a secondary suite as an accessory use, and Delta's SSMUH amendments also cover coach houses and garden suites.
faq.q: Are suites allowed on single detached lots here?
